title: Carrot, butter bean and smoked mackerel stew

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is plain home food; horseradish sauce is a traditional condiment like mustard, and the stock is ordinary stock.

supermarket.reason: Carrots, leeks, butter beans, spring greens, smoked mackerel and crème fraîche are all everyday supermarket items at normal prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: One large pan and a grater for the lemon zest, with simple softening and simmering.

works.reason: 600g carrots, two tins of beans, 250g mackerel and 600ml stock make a sensible stew for four, and the salty mackerel and horseradish cream season it well.

honest_times.reason: 20 minutes covers slicing leeks, chunking carrots, shredding greens, skinning the mackerel and zesting, and the 8+20+5 minutes of cooking roughly matches the 30 printed.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warming bean stew suits mid-March, and 600g of carrots make up the bulk of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Vegetables, pulses and oily fish make a filling, balanced family dinner.
